description: Use this for a Singapore company lookup from ACRA via data.gov.sg (Entities with UEN, Singapore Open Data Licence v1.0) by UEN or name. Legal name, UEN status (Registered/Deregistered/etc.), entity type, UEN issue date, registered street + postal code, red flags. Example: {uen:"196800306E"} (DBS BANK LTD.) or {name:"DBS BANK"}. $0.25 USDC.
name: sg_company
